card.name: Past-tense verb after a subject noun
card.fires_on: Past-tense verbs, mostly "did" in "did not", right after a subject noun such as a drug, risk or measure in study results. Also fires on "saw" or "needed" in narrative sentences.

modes.label: Past verb in narrative
modes.description: A past-tense verb in story text after a subject, where a "was" clause could follow.
modes.example: all I<< saw>> were a lot of waves.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward past-tense "was" and away from present-tense "is" and "are".
card.plain: It marks a past-tense verb after the subject, often "did" in a sentence saying a drug or factor made no difference.
